analysis.title: Pixel Art Startup Landing Page
analysis.notes: A vivid pixel-art meadow, tree, skyline, laptop, and notebook create a nostalgic but contemporary hero scene, with white interface text layered over the blue sky. The page transitions into a quiet off-white section with centered messaging and a faint product interface preview.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a wide, polished pixel-art website hero illustration in a nostalgic 16-bit game aesthetic: a bright blue sky with large soft clouds, a lush green meadow, distant modern city skyline, and a giant tree framing the right edge. Place an open silver laptop and a worn sketchbook in the foreground grass, with small flowers and a red ladybug nearby. Use crisp blocky pixels, rich layered foliage, atmospheric depth, strong blue-green contrast, and a hopeful entrepreneurial mood. Leave the upper-left sky relatively open for overlaid interface copy. No logos, brand names, characters, or readable text.
